GRADE 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. select appropriate reading materials from varied texts,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading completely.
   C. Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading.

2. About Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. read a variety of texts for enjoyment and general understanding,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading completely.
   C. Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading.

3. About Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. select appropriate reading materials from varied texts,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading completely.
   C. Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading.

5. About Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify simple, comparative and superlative forms of adjectives in print and digital texts correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives.

6. About Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use simple, comparative and superlative forms of adjectives in oral and written texts,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives.

7. About Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify simple, comparative and superlative forms of adjectives in print and digital texts correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives.

9. About Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. plan a narrative composition collaboratively,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing completely.
   C. Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing.

10. About Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. organise ideas coherently, clearly, and logically for writing fluency,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing completely.
   C. Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing.

11. About Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. create a narrative composition on a variety of topics.
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing completely.
   C. Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing.

13. About Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

14. About Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

15. About Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

17. About Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. make connections between events in the text and prior experiences,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading completely.
   C. Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading.

18. About Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use contextual clues to infer the meaning of vocabulary such as words, proverbs, fixed phrases, similes, and phrasal verbs,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading completely.
   C. Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading.

19. About Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to a reading text for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading completely.
   C. Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading.

21. About Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise phrasal quantifiers in oral and written contexts,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers.

22. About Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use phrasal quantifiers with countable and uncountable nouns correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers.

23. About Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise phrasal quantifiers in oral and written contexts,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers.

25. About Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. plan a composition in preparation for writing,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing completely.
   C. Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing.

26. About Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use appropriate words and expressions such as similes, metaphors, fixed phrases, phrasal verbs and idioms in written communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing completely.
   C. Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing.

27. About Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. create a pictorial composition from visuals.
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing completely.
   C. Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing.

29. About Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening.

30. About Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening.

31. About Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading in a conversation with a classmate.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives in a conversation with a classmate.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing in a conversation with a classmate.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary in a conversation with a classmate.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading in a conversation with a classmate.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers in a conversation with a classmate.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing in a conversation with a classmate.

32. Give two examples of how you can use Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening in a conversation with a classmate.
